title: The Pleasant evening in the garden
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：pleasant　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pleasant 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the builder wrote of ① a pleasant evening in the garden in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more pleasant than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the pleasant ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most pleasant evening in the garden anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1972 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too pleasant to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the pleasant ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a pleasant manner of the nurse, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as pleasant as the manner of the nurse they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was pleasant or not, and he said so.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something pleasant, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite pleasant; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the pleasant ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988, twice over, she wrote of another pleasant evening in the garden in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more pleasant than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most pleasant manner of the nurse in the whole site, she said in 1990, was the one she could never quite name; the pleasant ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 令人愉快（前置定语 a pleasant evening in the garden：1978 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件令人愉快的黄昏）
B. adj. 令人愉快／和善（比较级 more pleasant than：文中两处，一处比园里宜人的黄昏，一处比预想）
C. adj. 令人愉快／和善（最高级 the most pleasant：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 令人愉快（表语 too pleasant to do：母亲觉得它太令人愉快，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 和善（前置定语 a pleasant manner of the nurse：叔叔把整件事称作一桩和善的态度）
F. adj. 和善（同级比较 as pleasant as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩护士和善的态度相比）
G. adj. 和善（后置定语 something pleasant：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 和善（受程度副词修饰 quite pleasant：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a pleasant evening in the garden
the most pleasant evening in the garden anybody
a pleasant manner of the nurse
The most pleasant manner of the nurse in

answers.why: pleasant 意为“令人愉快”，1978 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件令人愉快的黄昏”，此处作前置定语 a pleasant evening in the garden。
pleasant 意为“令人愉快”，此处用比较级 more pleasant than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
pleasant 意为“令人愉快”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最令人愉快的一件，故用最高级 the most pleasant evening in the garden。
pleasant 意为“令人愉快”，母亲认为这件东西“太令人愉快了，谁也用不上”，too pleasant to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
pleasant 意为“和善”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩和善的态度”，此处作前置定语 a pleasant manner of the nurse。
pleasant 意为“和善”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩护士和善的态度一样和善”，同级比较用 as pleasant as。
pleasant 意为“和善”，施工图上那半行字要的是“和善的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something pleasant。
pleasant 意为“和善”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当和善”，quite 修饰原级 pleasant。
pleasant 意为“和善”，1988 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要和善”，故用比较级 more pleasant than。
pleasant 意为“和善”，母亲 1990 年说的是“整个工地里最和善的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most pleasant manner of the nurse。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件令人愉快的黄昏。（a pleasant evening in the garden）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更令人愉快。（more pleasant than …）
母亲觉得它太令人愉快，谁也用不上。（too pleasant to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩和善的态度。（a pleasant manner of the nurse）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩护士和善的态度一样和善。（as pleasant as …）
到了 1985 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件和善的东西。（something pleasant）
answers: In 1978 the builder wrote of a pleasant evening in the garden in the plan.
Everybody said it was more pleasant than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too pleasant to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a pleasant manner of the nurse.
He said nobody would call it as pleasant as the manner of the nurse they had once had.
By 1985 the plan asked for nothing but something pleasant.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 pleasant 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the builder wrote of a pleasant evening in the garden in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most pleasant evening in the garden in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too pleasant to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a pleasant manner of the nurse, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite pleasant, and everybody laughed.
The pleasant ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
